question: What did the Midianite's friend say the dream meant?
options: It was the sword of Gideon, and God had given the Midianites into his hands
A great famine was coming to Midian
Rain would soon fall on the camp
The king of Moab would help them win
explanation: His friend said the dream could mean nothing other than the sword of Gideon son of Joash, because God had given the whole camp into his hands.
